title: IsLinkedSpellContainer (spell flag)
html:
IsLinkedSpellContainer is a spell flag for variants of actions which should be granted with the parent action. For example, all the variants of  Chromatic Orb have this flag so learning Chromatic Orb will grant them all. Conversely, the variants of  Wild Shape do not have this flag so learning Wild Shape does not grant each one.
